throttle_effective_area_m2.source: NITRO-06: effective open-throttle area Cd*A from the NITRO-05 wide-open venturi depression estimate (4000 Pa, i.e. manifold ratio 0.9605) through the isentropic nozzle law (Heywood 1988 sec. 7.6.2) at the rated 11000 rpm and the profile breathing 0.850: capacity 0.00195 m3/s; derived from estimates, no carburettor measurement

idle_opening.source: NITRO-06: barrel open-area fraction at the idle stop giving the former per-cycle idle charge 0.35 at the declared 2800 rpm static idle (breathing 0.545) through the choked nozzle law; derived from estimates

throttle_travel_exponent.source: NITRO-06: barrel travel exponent calibrated so the static half-stick equilibrium on this propeller sits at 0.81 of the full-throttle static rpm (6306 of 7785 rpm), the operating band Menon 2010 (O.S. 46 FX, barrel carburettor, Fig. 7-11, read from the figure) gives for a half-open barrel on a matched propeller (78-84 %); another engine, a derived ratio, no linkage drawing
